title.zh: 轴对称圆电流丝 Green 响应

summary: Sum ordered weighted circular-filament responses at cylindrical target points.

identity.direction: source rows and target rows to per-target psi, BR, and BZ
identity.definition: Apply each source row weight to the circular-filament Green response and sum in source order.
identity.model: Axisymmetric ideal circular-filament kernel with zero-radius, zero-weight, and exact self conventions.
identity.geometry: Finite cylindrical source and target point tables.
identity.coordinates: R,Z in metres; weights dimensionless; outputs Wb/rad/A and T/A.
identity.boundary: Exact positive-radius source/target coincidence is skipped as a discrete zero-self entry; axis targets retain analytic limits.
assumptions: Inputs are finite real arrays with nonnegative radii.
The returned arrays follow target order.
No finite-wire or permeability model is included.

inputs.name: rzw
inputs.constraints: Finite with nonnegative source radii; an empty source set is allowed.

outputs.name: gpsi
outputs.constraints: Finite under the maintained singular-value convention.

outputs.name: gBR
outputs.description: Radial field response per drive current.
outputs.constraints: Finite under the maintained singular-value convention.

outputs.name: gBZ
outputs.description: Axial field response per drive current.
outputs.constraints: Finite under the maintained singular-value convention.

preconditions: Inputs are finite real arrays with nonnegative radii.
The returned arrays follow target order.
supported: Weighted source superposition, axis limits, empty sources, and finite output cases in direct tests.
excluded: Finite-wire self-fields, arbitrary-input qualification, and persistent field blocks.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for malformed, complex, nonfinite, or negative-radius source/target arrays.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError is raised when the summed finite response is not representable.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this is a direct sum.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result mapping is returned after validation or arithmetic failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel retains the documented scientific relation and tested implementation; this operator has no separate upstream approval or redistribution claim in the current development record.
provenance.license_status: No separate source license for this operator is declared in licenses/; retained upstream obligations remain unresolved and no public redistribution permission is asserted.

example.description: Evaluate one unit-weight filament at two off-axis targets.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field import circular_filament_green_response
result = circular_filament_green_response([[0.35, 0.0, 1.0]], [[0.2, -0.1], [0.2, 0.1]])
assert set(result) == {'gpsi', 'gBR', 'gBZ'}
for value in result.values():
    assert value.shape == (2,)
    assert np.isfinite(value).all()
example.expected: The mapping contains gpsi, gBR, and gBZ; each is a finite float64 vector of shape (2,).

scope: Midplane symmetry and analytic axis BZ check.
独立70/80位精度理想圆环关系核对极小正半径、近轴非零BR、近丝和公式求值分支，保持原数值断言与容差；精确离散自项与算术失败分别处理。
verification.evidence_ceiling: Verified for the maintained axisymmetric circular-filament relation and tested finite points; not an independent validation of arbitrary coil geometries or singular self-fields.
known_limitations: Targets exactly on a filament are not a resolved self-field model.
Public distribution licensing remains pending a human decision.
